skill.name: clinical-decision-support
skill.description: Generate professional clinical decision support (CDS) documents for pharmaceutical and clinical research settings, including patient cohort analyses (biomarker-stratified with outcomes) and treatment recommendation reports (evidence-based guidelines with decision algorithms). Supports GRADE evidence grading, statistical analysis (hazard ratios, survival curves, waterfall plots), biomarker integration, and regulatory compliance. Outputs publication-ready LaTeX/PDF format optimized for drug development, clinical research, and evidence synthesis.
skill.summary: Create population-level clinical research reports with biomarker analysis, evidence grading, statistics, and publication-ready LaTeX outputs.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: All 126 static alerts are false positives caused by clinical prose, TikZ syntax, Python list operations, expected output writes, and Markdown formatting. Two semantic risks remain: unescaped input in generated LaTeX and incomplete HIPAA identifier screening. No prompt injection, malicious networking, credential access, or system reconnaissance was found.

remediation.issue: Input-derived values are inserted into LaTeX without escaping.
remediation.suggestion: Escape LaTeX metacharacters, validate node identifiers, and compile generated documents in a restricted environment with shell escape disabled.

remediation.issue: The HIPAA validator can pass documents while checking only six identifier patterns.
remediation.suggestion: Implement all Safe Harbor identifier checks or label the feature as basic linting. Require deidentified input and independent privacy review before distribution.

content.value_statement: Clinical research teams need consistent cohort analyses and treatment evidence summaries. This skill structures statistics, biomarkers, recommendations, and LaTeX reports.
actual_capabilities: Structures population-level cohort analyses and evidence-based treatment recommendation reports.
Generates Kaplan-Meier curves, log-rank tests, Cox hazard ratios, and risk tables from CSV data.
Creates baseline, efficacy, and safety tables in CSV and LaTeX formats.
Builds TikZ clinical decision trees from text or JSON specifications.
Supports biomarker stratification and molecular subtype reporting with included references and templates.
Checks documents for required sections, citations, statistical reporting, nomenclature, and basic identifier patterns.
limitations: It is not intended for individual patient treatment decisions or bedside care.
Clinical claims, citations, approvals, and guidelines require current expert verification.
Python dependencies and a separate LaTeX environment are required for analysis and PDF compilation.
The included identifier checker does not establish HIPAA compliance or complete deidentification.

use_cases.title: Compare biomarker-defined cohorts
use_cases.description: Analyze deidentified group outcomes, survival differences, response rates, and safety results for a clinical research report.

use_cases.title: Develop evidence recommendations
use_cases.description: Organize trial evidence, assign transparent GRADE ratings, and create population-level treatment algorithms.

use_cases.title: Summarize molecular actionability
use_cases.description: Classify biomarker subgroups and connect validated assays with evidence-supported research implications.

prompt_templates.title: Outline a cohort report
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a population-level cohort report outline for [disease] and [treatment]. Include required data fields, outcomes, tables, figures, and evidence gaps.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning with no patient-level analysis

prompt_templates.title: Analyze biomarker cohorts
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this deidentified cohort by [biomarker groups]. Report sample sizes, ORR, PFS, OS, effect estimates, confidence intervals, missing data, and assumptions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate analysis of structured cohort data

prompt_templates.title: Grade treatment recommendations
prompt_templates.prompt: Synthesize the supplied evidence for [population]. Draft population-level recommendations with GRADE ratings, rationale, monitoring, contraindications, uncertainties, and verified citations only.

prompt_templates.title: Build an integrated CDS package
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a deidentified CDS package for [research question]. Include cohort statistics, biomarker interpretation, evidence tables, a decision algorithm, limitations, and LaTeX-ready sections.

output_examples.input: Summarize outcomes for deidentified biomarker-positive and biomarker-negative research cohorts.
output: Executive summary: Present sample sizes, response rates, median survival, and uncertainty for each cohort.
Analysis note: Label subgroup comparisons as exploratory unless they were prespecified.
Required review: Confirm model assumptions, missing data handling, and source values before publication.

output_examples.input: Draft evidence-based population recommendations for an advanced disease setting.
output: Recommendation table: State each option, target population, evidence quality, recommendation strength, and rationale.
Decision pathway: Branch on validated biomarkers, prior therapy, performance status, and major contraindications.
Evidence gap: Separate established standards from conditional options and research-only strategies.

output_examples.input: Prepare a biomarker actionability report from supplied evidence.
output_examples.output: The report groups validated, emerging, and investigational biomarkers, records assay methods, summarizes evidence, and flags every claim requiring current expert verification.

best_practices: Use deidentified, quality-checked data and retain a documented analysis plan.
Verify every clinical claim, citation, approval status, and evidence grade with current authoritative sources.
Review statistical assumptions, missing data, subgroup definitions, and generated LaTeX before publication.
anti_patterns: Do not use generated content as an individual patient treatment order.
Do not invent citations, trial results, biomarker thresholds, or statistical values.
Do not treat the basic identifier scan as proof of HIPAA compliance.

faq.question: Can this skill make individual treatment decisions?
faq.answer: No. It supports population-level research and evidence documents, not diagnosis, prescribing, or bedside decisions.

faq.question: What data formats do the scripts accept?
faq.answer: The analysis scripts use CSV data. The decision-tree builder accepts text or JSON specifications.

faq.question: Does it verify clinical evidence automatically?
faq.answer: No. Users must verify citations, guidelines, approval status, and clinical claims against current authoritative sources.

faq.question: Does it guarantee HIPAA compliance?
faq.answer: No. The included validator performs limited pattern checks and cannot replace formal deidentification or privacy review.

faq.question: What software is required?
faq.answer: Python packages include pandas, NumPy, SciPy, lifelines, and Matplotlib. PDF production also requires a suitable LaTeX installation.

faq.question: Which outputs can it create?
faq.answer: It can create report structures, CSV and LaTeX tables, survival figures, statistical summaries, biomarker classifications, and TikZ decision pathways.
